verdicts.why: Seed 'It's under the bridge' renders ఉంది as the contracted 's fused to 'It'; the gloss 'is' is an elided/clitic-fused word of its own sentence.
తర్వాత glossed 'after' while the seed renders it as 'next' in 'come next'; the row is about its own sentence, so this is a gloss-versus-translation mismatch, not a provable orphan.
వాళ్ళు 'they' is a literal gloss of a word the seed ('Whoever said it would be difficult was absolutely right') does not render.
నాకు 'to me' is part of the LEGO 'I'm not convinced', and the seed 'I'm not convinced…' renders it as the first-person subject, not as 'to me'.
'anywhere' glosses ఎక్కడైనా while the seed 'Somewhere warmer' has 'somewhere', a related form of the same word, so the row is about its own sentence.
లేదు 'not' is fused into 'doesn't' in the seed 'It doesn't feel like a long time', so the word is present but contracted.
ఉన్నావు 'are' is fused into 'You're' in the seed 'You're like someone I used to know', so it is a contraction of a word that is there.
ఆ 'that' is a literal gloss of a demonstrative that the seed renders only as 'the' in 'at the time'.
రాత్రి 'night' is a literal part of రాత్రి భోజనానికి 'for supper', which the seed renders as 'supper'; the row is about its own sentence.
ఉంది 'is' is fused into 'she's' in the seed 'Yes she's a friend of my mother', so it is a contracted word of its own sentence.
పాటు 'along' is a literal gloss of part of తనతో పాటు, which the seed renders as 'with her'.
ఇష్టం 'like' is a literal gloss of the ఇష్టం లేదు chunk, which the seed renders as 'I hate'; the row is about its own sentence.
'is talking' is split in the seed ('who's talking'), where 's is fused into 'who', so the words are present but contracted.
'will trust' is split in the seed ('I will never trust anyone'), where 'never' sits between 'will' and 'trust'.
'am not planning' is not contiguous in the seed, which has the contraction "I'm not planning".

ఉన్న 'which is at' is not contiguous in the seed ('The church at the other end…'), where the relative clause is rendered as 'at' alone.
'is interesting' is split in the seed ('is the most interesting'), where 'the most' sits between the words.

'to feel' is the infinitive of 'feel', which is in the seed 'It doesn't feel like a long time'.
